svg.aria-label: Route from The Wharf Mooloolaba to the estimated bar wave zone
svg.title: Estuary Rats — finding the bar
svg.desc: Original game guide using OpenStreetMap shoreline. The orange route follows the river, then turns left outside the entrance. Sandbanks are estimated game placements, not surveyed depths.
svg.text: Press N / tap BAR WAVES in the game for turn guidance. Calm seas switch to Rolling swell.
Map © OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL. Sandbanks and wave markers are approximate game features. Not for navigation.
